textures.name: sea
textures.prompt:
Aerial photograph taken straight down from very high above of calm deep
open sea, an even deep blue with a very fine, faint, uniform texture of
tiny ripples, low contrast, no foam, no glare, no sun reflection,
nothing else, filling the whole image.

textures.name: land
textures.prompt:
Satellite photograph taken straight down from very high above of a vast
tropical rainforest, the canopy seen as a fine, even, uniform texture of
countless tiny green tree crowns, low contrast, no clearings, no rivers,
nothing else, filling the whole image.

textures.name: sand
textures.prompt:
Aerial photograph taken straight down of pale golden beach sand, fine,
even and uniform, low contrast, nothing else, filling the whole image.

textures.name: town
textures.prompt:
Photograph from above at an angle of a single small 17th-century
Caribbean colonial house with white plastered walls, a red clay tile
roof, a dark door and two small windows, standing alone on a plain flat
light grey ground, nothing else.

textures.name: fort
textures.prompt:
Photograph from above at an angle of a single squat round stone tower of
a 17th-century Spanish fort, grey weathered stone with battlements on
top and a dark doorway, standing alone on a plain flat light grey
ground, nothing else.

textures.name: rock
textures.prompt:
Photograph from above of a single jagged grey rock outcrop of a reef,
wet dark stone, standing alone on a plain flat light grey ground,
nothing else.

textures.name: woods
textures.prompt:
Photograph from above at an angle of a single dense clump of tall dark
green tropical trees and palms with thick undergrowth, a small wood
soldiers could hide in, standing alone on a plain flat light grey
ground, nothing else.

textures.name: marsh
textures.prompt:
Photograph from above at an angle of a single small round clump of
tall green reeds and low mangrove bushes around one small dark muddy
pool, a lone patch of marsh like a tiny island, standing alone in the
middle of a plain flat light grey ground, nothing else.
